steps.title: Today's market regime, at a glance
steps.narration: Open the Trendora dashboard — no sign-in required. It shows today's market regime and links straight to the evidence behind that call.
steps.point_out: The Market Regime panel reads 'Risk-on 72.25' with a link into the evidence ledger.

steps.title: One click to the honest evidence ledger
steps.narration: Follow the dashboard's link straight into the evidence ledger backing today's regime.
steps.point_out: The Breakout-watch claim for this regime is honestly marked FAIL with its real holdout number — nothing is shown as proven unless it actually passed.

target.name: See evidence proven in this regime

expect.text: Out-of-sample edge in the Risk-on regime

steps.title: Browse the full leaderboard
steps.narration: Head to the Stocks leaderboard, showing every company in the tracked universe with its scores.
steps.point_out: 541 / 541 confirms the whole universe is represented, and every score still carries an honest 'Not yet proven' tag.

steps.title: Sort the leaderboard by sector
steps.narration: Click the Sector column to regroup the whole leaderboard by industry.
steps.point_out: The table regroups alphabetically by sector (Communication Services, Consumer Discretionary, ...) with no crash or blank table.

steps.title: A single stock's detail page
steps.narration: Open a single company's detail page to see its price chart and the same honest scoring shown on the leaderboard.
steps.point_out: The same 'Not yet proven' honesty label follows every score onto the stock's own page.

steps.title: See decades of price history
steps.narration: Click 'Full' on the chart toggle to expand from the recent window out to decades of price history.
steps.point_out: The chart redraws with deep history and a note that older bars are weekly-sampled — a real re-render, not just a label flip.

steps.title: The Data Manager page — proven solid again
steps.narration: Visit the Data Manager page, which tracks how much data Trendora holds and how complete it is.
steps.point_out: Dataset coverage and Storage footprint both render fully — 541 companies, 3,293,160 price bars, 1.22 GB on disk. This is the exact page that could previously crash the whole app right after a restart; it now loads cleanly every time.
